_readme: Copy to .image-fixtures/manifest.json and put the referenced JPGs alongside it (gitignored). 'catalog' = inventory products the verifier may choose from — include BOTH colourways of any near-duplicate product. 'cases' = labelled customer photos (IG screenshots) with the product they SHOULD match; set expectedProductId=null for an ABSTAIN case (garbage/ambiguous must return none). 'mustNotMatchProductIds' = wrong colourways it must NEVER resolve to. Run: RUN_IMAGE_ACCURACY=1 GEMINI_API_KEY=... IMAGE_VERIFY_WITH_AI=true IMAGE_SEGMENTATION_ENABLED=true npx vitest run src/ai/imageAccuracy.test.ts

cases.note: IG-live black/silver bandhani on rack — must pick BLACK Gajji, never RED
mint multicolour-leaf — must NOT resolve to the cream colourway
cream multicolour-leaf — must NOT resolve to the mint colourway
ABSTAIN: random / unrelated photo must return NONE (no hallucinated match)
